verdict.rationale: There is no first-party library of ready-made project templates. The closest evidence is a community-built hub (crawl4ai.dev) offering one-click Docker setups for n8n/FastAPI and MCP server guides, plus an official interactive playground that generates request code. These are partial stand-ins: the first is third-party and the second produces snippets, not project templates. Missing for 10: official template gallery or starter-project scaffolding, first-party documentation of templates, and hands-on corroboration that templates enable immediate project start.
